root_cause: Order-gateway error rate is high (30.1%) consistently across instances at 09:10, despite low memory, CPU, and moderate latency (7.5 ms). This suggests internal functional errors rather than resource or dependency failure. The recent active change CHG-4310 deployed order-gateway 2.4.0 with connection pooling changes, which coincides with the timing of the incident. No logs directly link the change to the error but timing implicates CHG-4310 as suspected cause.
summary: Escalated to on-call: The investigator found a suspected cause (the recent change CHG-4310) but did not propose a concrete mitigation action. The reviewer cannot approve an action that was not proposed. Hence, escalation is needed for further expertise or decision on rollback or other mitigation.
